parallels.text: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheepʼs clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.

crossrefs.text: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt
For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak; but the sleek and strong I will destroy. I will shepherd them with justice.’

parallels.text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in menʼs faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”

crossrefs.text: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
“Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!

Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword. For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division. From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three. They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”

the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped. Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

parallels.text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

crossrefs.text: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
For it is My Fatherʼs will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”

I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,

Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people. News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and He healed them. Large crowds followed Him, having come from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
